finalText:
**Migrated 12 files off `db.query`.** All 36 call sites now use `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

`node --check` passes on every file. No test runner in the repo.

Two calls stay in [vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9](vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js:9). Its header says do not edit. Upgrades overwrite it. `lib/db.js` still ships `query` as deprecated.

Next: wrap or drop the vendored adapter before the driver's next major.
